question: Can a conservative hierarchical full-vector centroid/radius index certify the pinned greedy sampler while avoiding more than 5% of physical output-head weight traffic across the same 32 real decode rows?
causal_hypothesis: A balanced random-projection tree can place nearby tied-head rows into a permuted contiguous layout. Full-vector BF16 centroids and conservative L2 radii at 4096-, 256-, and 32-row levels may reject whole subtrees before member weights are read. The expected falsifier is high-dimensional concentration: even proximity-sorted 32-row leaves retain radii large enough that the 32-query physical survivor union approaches the full vocabulary.

stock_control.workload_sampler: The pinned exact-c32 request bodies set temperature=0, min_tokens=max_tokens, ignore_eos=true, and do not request logprobs. Pinned SGLang v0.5.13 commit 28b095c01005d4a3a2a5b637b7d028b07fba31b2 normalizes temperature zero to top_k=1, sets SamplingBatchInfo.is_all_greedy, applies the min-new-token stop mask before sampling, and returns torch.argmax(logits, -1). The required candidate set is every possible non-stop stock argmax under the conservative numeric envelope.

candidate.name: balanced random-projection hierarchy with full-vector centroid/radius bounds
candidate.layout: Rows are recursively median-partitioned by deterministic random full-vector projections, yielding a permuted contiguous leaf layout.
candidate.bound: dot(hidden, BF16 centroid) plus a guarded FP32 centroid-dot error, hidden L2 norm times a guarded full-vector cluster radius, and the inherited conservative stock BF16 matmul/output-rounding envelope.
candidate.traversal: Evaluate all top-level centroids, then only child-centroid metadata beneath surviving parents, then exact-rescore every member of surviving 32-row leaves.
incumbents: implementable full-rescore lower bound of the maximum random-projection-tree centroid seed row
optimistic maximum dense-reference stock lower bound

workload.rows: one deterministic hidden row from each of 32 exact c32 requests, identical to the predecessor selection
workload.physical_scope: union of centroid metadata and 32-row leaf member weights touched by any of the 32 queries

correctness_gate.semantics: lossless certification of the pinned temperature-zero greedy sampler
required: all bound inputs and source identities match
every pruned subtree has a conservative stock upper bound below a feasible stock lower bound
every dense-reference possible winner remains in the final survivor set
all 262144 token rows remain reachable through the permutation

decision_gate.promote: gross physical member-weight union avoidance exceeds 5%, optimistic net bytes after all traversed centroid/radius metadata are positive, and the exact stock greedy candidate set is certified
decision_gate.falsify: gross physical member-weight union avoidance is at most 5%, optimistic net byte/time bound is non-positive, or stock certification fails
decision_gate.transfer_limit: CPU/reference pruning and analytical bytes only; a positive result promotes only an H200 exact-consumer component.

artifact_contract.teardown: foreground CPU process exits; immutable hard-linked inputs remain read-only; no provider or GPU state exists
